h: Shabbos Completes Human Reverence With the Gift of Divine Love

p: In the Zohar Chadash (on this parshah):
'To bestow substance upon those who love Me, etc.'
Knesses Yisrael, the seed of Yaakov,
'To bestow substance upon those who love Me'
The secret of Yovel and Shemittah,
and not to the nations of the world;
so what is special about Yovel and Shemittah?
he speaks of the secret of Yovel and Shemittah,
and this is the holiness of Shabbos.
דְּאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב רד, א)
For it says in the holy Zohar (II 204a):
shin is the secret of the three Avos,
and the 'daughter' is crowned with them";
and in the Raya Mehemna (Pinchas, III 257a)
and the 'daughter' is the fourth to them."
and they are a chariot for the three middos
and each middah is composed of ten,
in the manner of what is written in the Raya Mehemna
And the Avos are crowned with the three upper sefiros,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א רז, א)
as stated in the holy Zohar (I 207a)
that he ascended into the World to Come;
and Binah includes all three upper ones,
and this is shin, three hundred.
the "daughter" is crowned with the three upper sefiros
Now in the Mishnah (end of Uktzin)
that the Holy One, blessed be He, is destined
And the matter of the count of three hundred ten worlds:
דְּאִיתָא (בְּתוֹסֶפְתָּא זֹהַר חֵלֶק א קכג, עַמּוּד ב)
for it says (in the Tosefta, Zohar I 123b):
אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שֶׁקֶל כֶּסֶף (בְּרֵאשִׁית כג, טו)
and longings in the World to Come";
That is, each tzaddik from his own side
in which to put them? etc.
אִם יֵשׁ לוֹ יִרְאַת חֵטְא כּוּלֵּי
if he has fear of sin, etc."
And the tzaddik's treasuries are tzadi, ninety:
for the middah of Tzaddik is the ninth middah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (הַקְדָּמָה ה, ב)
as stated in the holy Zohar (Introduction, I 5b)
from His side, out of His love for the tzaddik.
And this is what it says:
that the Holy One, blessed be He, is destined
"To bestow substance upon those who love Me,
and their treasuries I will fill";
the four hundred worlds of longing.
And this too is alluded to here
Hashem Yisbarach bestowed out of His love;
"with love and favor He bestowed it upon us,"
(וְכֵן כָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר חֵלֶק ב מז, עַמּוּד א
(and so it is written in Zohar II 47a:
"And out of His love for them, etc.,
And this is what he says:
"To bestow upon those who love Me
this is the secret of Yovel and Shemittah,
which is the lower Shabbos and the upper Shabbos:
the three holinesses of the Avos
and from the World to Come;
which Hashem Yisbarach bestows out of love.
the Holy One, blessed be He,
And this is what it says (in Sanhedrin 58b):
And in the Midrash (Shemos Rabbah, end of 25):
"A parable of a king and a matron
